sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: A connected view that helps interpret records without replacing their owners.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: A single note says little; linking it to a project, a decision and the evidence explains its context.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A decision can be understood alongside the document versions that supported it.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: The graph retains semantic records, evidence and decision history under stable contracts.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Agents need explainable context rather than disconnected copies of files.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: The accepted ADR assigns semantic context to Neo4j and operations to SQLite.
